Solid X and solid Y are both pure substances that contain ions.
X is not an electrical conductor.
Y is an electrical conductor.
Which statements about X and Y are correct?
1
X is a compound. Y is an element.
The ions in X are held in a lattice. The ions in Y are not held in a lattice.
2
3
X contains both positive and negative ions. Y contains positive ions but no
negative ions.
A
B
C
D
1, 2 and 3
1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
